description.en: Logical aggregate representing the 14 TPCs implied by the RTX 3060's 28 SMs and NVIDIA's GA10x two-SM-per-TPC organization. The numbered child TPCs each group two numbered SM entries and one PolyMorph Engine node for navigation. Group indices are logical only; no GA106 physical coordinates, GPC membership or die floorplan are asserted.

Нумерованные дочерние TPC объединяют по два нумерованных SM и один узел PolyMorph Engine для навигации. Индексы групп логические; физические координаты GA106, принадлежность к GPC и топология кристалла не утверждаются.

description.en: One enumerated member of the 28-SM RTX 3060 configuration. The two-digit suffix is a navigation index only, not a silicon serial number, physical coordinate or floorplan location. GA10x architecture specifies 128 CUDA cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, four texture units and one second-generation RT Core per SM, plus a 256 KB register file and 128 KB configurable L1/shared memory.
